text:
Alice Chen: Quick question — the burn-preview slider in the console: can we surface route-level quota impacts alongside token burn estimates? I want PMs to preview how a canary will affect tenant quotas.

Raj Patel: Love the idea. Two caveats: 1) token burn != compute cost; preview should flag model SKU and quantization tier. 2) cache savings are hard to attribute per-route, we have shared prefetch.

Maya Rivera: For UX, showing both absolute tokens and an amortized per-request cost line reduces confusion. Maybe fold in a 'likely cache credit' estimate with confidence bands.

Zoe (UX): +1. Sketch: left pane slider, middle chart with "tokens / est. cost" and a faint band for cache savings, right pane quota delta. Users can toggle 'show amortized model cost'.

Raj Patel: Implementation notes:
- We can approximate cache credit = historical prefix hits * avg_token_savings.
- Sampling caveat: if sample rate < 1% numbers are noisy.

Alice Chen: OK. How about rollout: preview slider should be able to simulate sticky routing -> some percent of traffic pinned to new model. That changes cache locality.

Maya Rivera: Good point. Add a small toggle: `simulate_sticky_routing=true/false` in preview. UI should call the preview API with params `{route, percent, sticky}`.

Raj Patel: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/econ/preview
{ "route": "tenant/foo", "percent": 10, "sticky": true, "model_sku": "rwd-7b-quant" }
```
Return: `tokens_est`, `est_cost_usd`, `cache_credit_est` (with confidence)

Alice Chen: Who owns the preview backend? Will it use live telemetry or a snapshot? Need to avoid heavy load on prod.

Maya Rivera: Plan: run preview queries against compact daily aggregates (precomputed) + optional on-demand sample run (rate-limited). That keeps latency low.

Zoe (UX): UX ask: surface a short sentence under the chart: "Estimates use last 7 days of traffic; toggle sample run to include current hour." Also add `:warning:` when confidence < 0.6.

Raj Patel: One more: backfill question — finance wants per-tenant amortized model cost in invoices. Preview should be conservative and not promise invoiced numbers.

Alice Chen: Agreed. Add copy: "Preview is estimative only; final invoices use billing pipeline." 

deploy-bot: rollout initiated for feature/preview-econ at canary (10%) — 1718112275

Maya Rivera: I'll follow up with an engineering checklist: precompute job, preview API, console widget, unit tests.

Alice Chen: Thanks team. Can we meet tomorrow 10am sync to finalize scope? @Raj @Maya @Zoe

Raj Patel: yep

Maya Rivera: yep

Zoe (UX): yep :+1:
